basic_profile.bio: A passionate book enthusiast and dedicated parent, living in the picturesque Azores. I spend most of my free time exploring toddler-friendly books and engaging in lively discussions about children's literature. As an accountant by profession, I juggle numbers by day and stories by night. My love for storytelling extends to my online life, where I frequently discuss favorite reads in various subreddits. Typically active during the evening hours, I enjoy unwinding with a good book or a binge-worthy TV series like Supergirl. Happily married, I share my love for literature with my partner and our curious little one.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in accounting, I have developed an analytical yet creative mind. My love for books started at a young age, and I have curated a vast collection over the years. Constantly seeking new knowledge, I often delve into educational resources to expand my understanding of child development and literature.
